assets.name: Tir Gwanwyn
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: territorial category BANNER for the Barony Tir Gwanwyn in the former kingdom Vennyr, NOT a circular clan coat of arms. Generate ONE individual hanging medieval fantasy regional flag, isolated on a genuinely transparent PNG background. Reference 1 (Tir Dwyrain) and reference 2 (Tir Brocair) define the banner format, medium and proportions: narrow vertical pennant of painted heavy cloth, pointed bottom, full dark wrought-iron horizontal suspension rod, restrained bronze fittings, small complete spear finials, flat frontal view. Reference 3 is the baronial HOUSE Illygoden's identity/motif reference only; preserve its black-and-ivory palette but do NOT copy the circular shield or the mouse knight. New independent territorial design: an ivory river winding between two black banks below a small silver-white stone bridge and a budding silver branch. Large clear heraldic forms, dark contours, subtle cloth texture, black, warm ivory and muted silver. A few simple medieval knot ornaments on the top band. Exactly one banner, fully shown with generous margin, 2:3 portrait composition. No writing, names, letters, scenery, person, extra banners, photo-realism, floor, shadow, glow or backdrop. The entire cloth and its motif must be opaque, only outside the entire banner/rod silhouette alpha=0. Match the restrained hand-painted heraldic atlas style of the first two references. This is explicitly a regional banner, retain the pointed flag silhouette; do not turn it into a circular family emblem.

assets.name: Tir Gwawr

Frontal flat composition, hand-painted medieval atlas heraldry with bold dark outlines and subtle cloth grain. A black sea cliff carrying one ivory watchtower, a small rising golden sun behind it, three turquoise waves below. A small black shark silhouette under the lowest wave recalls Gwaedlyd. Complete banner entirely within the canvas at 80-85% height and width with 8% transparent margin on ALL sides including the suspension cord. 2:3 portrait. Every part of the banner and its painted design fully opaque. True transparent PNG exterior: alpha=0 immediately outside the hard silhouette, no background color or semitransparent haze. NO external shadows, ambient shadow, glow, halo, vignette, ground, scene, writing, labels, letters or extra items. Exact match of the restrained heraldic cloth treatment in reference1.
